title: Sealed qualification-set custody manifest
description: Content-free public custody manifest (1.2.0, stage-separated private layout). SHA-256 digests provide integrity, not confidentiality. This document is not encryption and is not a cryptographic seal. Replay protection applies only to the selected custody location and is not a global anti-replay guarantee. It must not contain task bodies, accepted answers, scenario names, private filenames, or task identifiers. Key management is outside this schema. Packages written under the 1.1.0 combined-index layout are immutable historical custody objects; they are not migrated and are not execution-eligible.

private_layout.description: Each stage has its own private index (private/<stage>/index.json) and blob directory (private/<stage>/blobs/). A stage-specific reader touches only its own stage directory.

integrity_statement.const: SHA-256 digests provide integrity, not confidentiality. This manifest is not encryption and is not a cryptographic seal. Replay protection applies only to the selected custody location and is not a global anti-replay guarantee.

replay_scope.description: Replay rejection applies only to this custody directory. It is not a global anti-replay guarantee.

request_version.description: Import-request schema and tool version bound into the request digest.

controller_commit.description: Frozen canonical Git commit whose controller blobs were verified.

controller_digest.description: Digest of the controller source blobs stored in controller_commit. The running sources must match those blobs.

set_identity.description: Order-sensitive identity of the stage content digests. Task identifiers and bodies are omitted.

development_index_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical development-private index document. Lets a development-only reader verify its index without touching holdout.

holdout_index_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical holdout-private index document. Lets a holdout-only reader verify its index without touching development.

import_request_digest.description: SHA-256 of the content-free import request. The approval phrase binds this digest.

file_digests.description: Sorted per-file content digests for both stages. Identifiers and filenames are omitted.

custody_manifest_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical manifest bytes with this field excluded.
